goal: Watch the Annabelle Serpentine Dance film, meet the compelling question, and learn the dance space: own spot, the bubble and the freeze on the drum.

Equipment: hand drum, or a pot and a wooden spoon (free path). Floor tape or chalk for spots and zones.

goal: Learn the warm-up from the warm-up card and travel among the group, then freeze in own space on the drum.

Physical education K unit 1 (weeks 1 to 6) teaches traveling as motor skill in the same weeks: this day uses only walks and stretches a kindergartner already makes and teaches the dance cue, assuming no physical education cue.

goal: Play the start and stop game: travel, freeze on the drum and find own spot again, three rounds.
note: Baseline look at the unit's main look-for (own space and the stop cue), rotating groups, marked met, partly or not yet; no score from day 1 or 2.

goal: Copy matching-side moves and simple shapes from the teacher and the step card, in place.
note: Step card shown, then carried by the class. Same-side moves only; uses bend, stretch and twist a child already has (physical education K unit 2, weeks 6 to 10, teaches in-place moves as motor skill).

goal: Copy crossing moves (a hand to the other knee) and a four-move body pattern, in place and then traveling.
note: Step card carried, then withdrawn for the last run.

goal: Run the four-move pattern three times, in place and traveling, with the step card withdrawn on the last run.
note: Pattern practice with feedback; the freeze cue between runs. Fold-in day (shorter path): no baseline look, no candidate work and nothing assessed; its practice folds into the next day's warm-up.

goal: Move one body part in relation to another: elbow to knee, hand over head, back to back with no touching.
note: Back-to-back moves with no touching unless both children agree; partner contact never required.

goal: Repeat a move when asked, then recall a move from an earlier day after the teacher stops showing it.
note: Recall after the demonstration stops (the 2026-11-26 fix): the teacher shows, then stands still while the class repeats.

goal: Make shapes with straight and curved lines at high and low levels, using the elements card in pictures.

goal: Make big and small shapes, then form the group circle and make it bigger and smaller by stepping out and in.

goal: Play the shapes game: straight, curved, high, low, big and small on the called card, and grow and shrink the circle.

goal: Match walking speed to the drum's tempo, slow and fast, and freeze when the drum stops.
